reason: I already own a few English mind-reading apps, but a Hebrew one that works with family here is new to me, and 99 ₪ one time is small for a collector. I'd try the free tricks first, and if the gallery and calculator reveals look clean, I'd pay.
objection: How long it takes to learn and set up, and whether it's really better than the apps I already own. A browser install outside the App Store also makes me wonder if it will keep working after the next phone update.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks look clunky or take more than ten minutes to set up for a convincing reveal, I'd skip it and stick with what I have.
